svg.title: The straddle region of a short segment is a band with positive area
svg.desc: A horizontal segment K of length 0.6, with its two endpoints marked. The shaded region Delta(K) is the open radius-one capsule around K with the white lens removed where the two closed unit disks centred at the endpoints overlap. It forms a ring, thick to the left and right of K and thin above and below it. The unit circle of the midpoint of K is drawn dashed in blue: it runs through the middle of both thick parts of the band, touching the outer boundary only at the top and bottom. It is one of the circles that sweep the band, and alone it has zero area.

g.text: Many centres thicken a circle into a band
Δ(K): some point of K is closer than 1, some point farther than 1.
Outside the band all of K is at least 1 away; inside the white lens all of K is within 1.
Dashed blue: the unit circle of the midpoint of K. It runs through the band, but alone it has zero area.
The shaded band Δ(K) has positive area.
